title: Patient-aware projection of frozen recurrent malignant programs across ESCC carcinogenesis
qc: 200 <= detected genes < 6000 and mitochondrial UMI fraction < 5%
cell_scoring: Phase E deterministic within-cell rank score on raw nonnegative UMI counts; covered genes only; zero counts tied low; no imputation/substitution/training
patient_state_summary: unweighted median of sample-level median scores
primary_model: RMP_score ~ ordered_state + (1|patient), REML random-intercept mixed model
fallback_model: within-patient centered fixed-effect regression with patient-cluster-robust SE, only if MixedLM fails to converge
permutation: 10,000 patient-blocked label permutations within each patient's observed states; mixed-model GLS statistic with observed variance components
primary_multiple_testing: BH across five Tier-1 Top50 ordered-state permutation P values
lopo_major_instability_rule: abs(full slope) >= full SE and <80% LOPO slopes preserve sign
supported_rule: permutation BH FDR <0.05, mixed-model 95% CI excludes zero, LOPO sign fraction >=0.80, and no major instability
limited_rule: nominal patient-aware permutation or mixed-model P <0.05 with LOPO sign fraction >=0.80 but supported rule not met
c02_c07_distinct_rule: difference-score trend CI excludes zero, blocked permutation P<0.05, and LOPO sign fraction>=0.80
